FABLE_BURDEN.BurdenHint: Leave blank to use the default for this item.
FABLE_BURDEN.AttunementDisabled: Attunement is disabled. This world uses Burden instead.
FABLE_BURDEN.OverCapacityWarn: {actor} is over Burden capacity ({used} of {capacity}) after equipping {item}.
FABLE_BURDEN.OverCapacityBlock: {actor} cannot equip {item}. It costs {burden} Burden and only {free} is free.

Enforcement.Name: Burden limit
Enforcement.Hint: What happens when equipping an item would put a character over capacity. Blocking does not apply to GMs, who get a warning instead.

CapacityBonus.Name: Capacity bonus
CapacityBonus.Hint: Burden capacity is proficiency bonus plus this number. The default of 1 gives 3 at level 1 and 7 at level 17.

RarityTable.Name: Burden by rarity
RarityTable.Hint: JSON. Default Burden for items that used to need attunement. Keys are dnd5e rarity keys (veryRare is shown as Epic). Edit a number or add a rarity key.

OptionalCounts.Name: Optional attunement costs Burden
OptionalCounts.Hint: Items with optional attunement are free by default. Turn this on to charge them Burden too.

RemoveAttunement.Name: Remove attunement
RemoveAttunement.Hint: Items that needed attunement work whenever they are equipped, and the attunement controls are hidden. Requires a reload.

FableRarities.Name: Use the Fable rarity ladder
FableRarities.Hint: Shows Very Rare as Epic and adds Unique and Mythical. Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Unique, Legendary, Mythical, Artifact. Requires a reload.
